title: Contracts (time-limited delivery goals, bonus on completion, no failure penalty)

maxOpenContracts.description: Open contracts Core tops up to at game start and each new month. 0 disables contracts.

minAmount.description: Inclusive minimum units a contract asks for.

maxAmount.description: Inclusive maximum units a contract asks for (not below minAmount).

durationMonths.description: Calendar months a contract stays open after it appears.

rewardMultiplier.description: Completion bonus = amount x cargo price per unit x this multiplier, rounded down.

townPopulationBonus.description: Inhabitants added to a town when a contract targeting it completes (capped at the town maximum).
